helpful: Provisioned application.txt gave the full ask, the split, and the procedural history without any retrieval.
Statpack interim section made the strictly-prior pool arithmetic direct.
fedcourts query --include-applications rows carry response_requested / referred_to_court / amicus_briefs, so a local conditional tally was possible.

gaps: fedcourts query caps at 500 rows through the service and has no filter on application_kind, escalation signals, or applicant class.
No committed interim cut conditioning the base rate on response-requested / referred / amicus, which is the signal an interim cell actually turns on.
CourtListener's docket index returned nothing for this SCOTUS matter; live application state had to come from supremecourt.gov HTML.
notes: Four corpus queries (one refused on the limit cap), one MCP search, two web searches, seven page fetches; inside the advisory budget.
